LanguageData.VCE_BoringCarols.stages.0.description: The leader treated us like children, wanting so desperately to hear something to lift their spirits.
LanguageData.VCE_BoringCarols.stages.0.label: boring festive singing
LanguageData.VCE_BoringFeast.stages.0.description: We just went throught he motions, without putting much heart into it. The food was a bit bland.
LanguageData.VCE_BoringFeast.stages.0.label: boring festive feast
LanguageData.VCE_FunCarols.stages.0.description: The leader lifted our spirits and made us feel a festive spirit that will only make us stronger.
LanguageData.VCE_FunCarols.stages.0.label: fun festive singing
LanguageData.VCE_FunFeast.stages.0.description: Gathering together to share a festive feast really enhances the spirit of the season.
LanguageData.VCE_FunFeast.stages.0.label: fun festive feast
LanguageData.VCE_TerribleCarols.stages.0.description: The leader displayed a lack of passion and the festive feeling just wasn't there.
LanguageData.VCE_TerribleCarols.stages.0.label: terrible festive singing
LanguageData.VCE_TerribleFeast.stages.0.description: The food was disgusting and we just quarreled and bickered through all of it.
LanguageData.VCE_TerribleFeast.stages.0.label: terrible festive feast
LanguageData.VCE_UnforgettableCarols.stages.0.descrip: We can still hear the mesmerizing words of the carols, as they reminded us of the importance of our shared beliefs. We can just feel our sadness vanish away.
LanguageData.VCE_UnforgettableCarols.stages.0.label: unforgettable festive singing
LanguageData.VCE_UnforgettableFeast.stages.0.descript: We truly felt like a big family and the food was just simply amazing!
LanguageData.VCE_UnforgettableFeast.stages.0.label: unforgettable festive feast
